CustomField.description: Calculated feild to show the regular payment premiums for an account in good standing
CustomField.formula: ((GrossWrittenPremium + StandardFeeAmount + StandardTaxAmount + TaxesSurcharges) / (YEAR(DATEVALUE(ExpirationDate)) - YEAR(DATEVALUE(EffectiveDate)) + IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE(ExpirationDate)) - MONTH(DATEVALUE(EffectiveDate)) <> 0, (MONTH(DATEVALUE(ExpirationDate)) - MONTH(DATEVALUE(EffectiveDate)))/12, 0)) / CASE( Text(PremiumFrequency), 'Monthly', 12, 'Semi-Monthly(twice a month)', 24, 'Quarterly', 4, 'Semi Annual(twice a year)', 2, 1))
CustomField.label: Periodic payment amount
